agenda_text:
AGENDA

  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL

AZUSA LIGHT AND WATER CONFERENCE ROOM  MONDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2019
729 N. AZUSA AVENUE  6:00 P.M.
AZUSA, CA 91702

  AZUSA CITY COUNCIL

  JOSEPH ROMERO ROCHA
  MAYOR

EDWARD J. ALVAREZ  ANGEL CARRILLO
MAYOR PRO-TEM  COUNCILMEMBER

URIEL E. MACIAS  ROBERT GONZALES
COUNCILMEMBER  COUNCILMEMBER

A.  PRELIMINARY BUSINESS.

 1. Call to Order
 2. Roll Call
 3. Flag Salute

B. PUBLIC COMMENT – Limited to items listed on this Special Meeting Notice.

Each person or representative of a group shall be allowed to speak without interruption for up to five (5)
continuous minutes, subject to compliance with applicable meeting rules, on items listed on this agenda only.
Questions to the speaker or responses to the speaker's questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker
has completed his/her comments.

C.  BOARD AND COMMISSIONS INTERVIEW AND APPOINTMENTS.

  1. City Council to Interview Candidates for City Boards and Commissions.

  • Cultural & Historic Preservation Commission (1 Position)
  • Library Commission (2 Positions)
   • Park & Recreation Commission (4 Positions)
  • Personnel Board (1 Position)
  • Planning Commission (2 Positions)

D.  ARTS IN PUBLIC PLACES COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS.

  1. Each Council Member to appoint one Commissioner from an existing City Commission to serve on the
  Arts in Public Places Commission.

E.  ADJOURNMENT.

In compliance with Government Code Section 54957.5, agenda materials are available for inspection by
members of the public at the following locations: Azusa City Clerk’s Office - 213 E. Foothill Boulevard,
Azusa City Library - 729 N. Dalton Avenue, and Azusa Police Department Lobby - 725 N. Alameda,
Azusa, California. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance
to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3)
working days prior to the meeting when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that
reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.

CERTIFICATION

I, Adrian Garcia, MMC, Chief Deputy City Clerk of the City of Azusa, or my designee, hereby certify under
penalty of perjury that a true, accurate copy of the foregoing agenda was posted on October 9, 2019, twenty-
four (24) hours prior to the meeting per Government Code 54956 at the City Clerk’s Office, 213 E. Foothill
Blvd.; the lobby of the Police Department, 725 N. Alameda Ave.; the Civic Auditorium, 213 E. Foothill Blvd.;
the City Library, 729 N. Dalton Ave.; and on the City’s Web Page at www.ci.azusa.ca.us.

______________________________________
Adrian Garcia, MMC
Chief Deputy City Clerk
Azusa City Clerk’s Office

   NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA

 A. PRELIMINARY BUSINESS.
  1. Call To Order
  2. Roll Call
  3. Flag Salute
 B. PUBLIC COMMENT.
 C. BOARD AND COMMISSION INTERVIEW AND APPOINTMENTS.

 D. ARTS IN PUBLIC PLACES COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS.

 E. ADJOURNMENT.
Dated: October 9, 2019

________________________  _____________________________
Joseph Romero Rocha, Mayor  Jeffrey L. Cornejo, Jr., City Clerk

minutes_text:
CITY OF AZUSA
  MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL
  MONDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2019 – 6:00 P.M.

The City Council, of the City of Azusa, met in Special Session at the above date and time in the Azusa Light & Water
Conference Room, located at 729 N. Azusa Avenue, Azusa, California.

Mayor Pro-Tem Alvarez called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL: Roll call was taken by City Clerk Cornejo.

PRESENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: GONZALES, CARRILLO, ALVAREZ, MACIAS
ABSENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: ROCHA

ALSO PRESENT

Elected Officials: City Clerk Cornejo.

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Pro-Tem Alvarez.

PUBLIC COMMENT

None given.

BOARD AND COMMISSIONS INTERVIEWS AND APPOINTMENTS

The City Council considered the following candidates for the open seats to the various City Commissions and made
recommendations for appointments for October 21, 2019 regular meeting:

Cultural & Historic Preservation Commission (1 Positions)
Candidates: Steven Ramirez Robles and Victor Eduardo Munoz
Recommendation for Appointment: Steven Ramirez Robles
Library Commission (2 Position)
Candidate: Joyce Hsiao, Catherine Datko, and Sabrina Bow
Recommendation for Appointment: Joyce Hsiao and Sabrina Bow
Personnel Board (1 Position)
Candidates: Mercedes Castro, Thomas Sanchez and Victor Eduardo Munoz
Recommendation for Appointment: Victor Eduardo Munoz
Planning Commission (2 Positions)
Candidates: Mark Caro, Mercedes Castro, Steven Ramirez Robles, Russ Rentschler, Karen Marie Baumgartner, Doug
  Cummings, Frank Allen, Fred Madjar and Victor Eduardo Munoz
Recommendation for Appointment: Frank Allen and Mercedes Castro
Park & Recreation Commission (4 Positions)
Candidates: Gerard Batista, Thomas Sanchez, Pam Mercado, Jose Torres, Suzanne Avila and Rossana Helbert
Recommendation for Appointment: Gerard Batista, Jose Torres, Pam Mercado and Rossana Helbert

ADJOURNMENT

It was consensus of the Council to adjourn the meeting.

TIME OF ADJOURNMENT: 9:46 P.M.

_________________________________
CITY CLERK
